candidate.title: Predicting transcriptional responses to novel chemical perturbations using deep generative model for drug discovery.
candidate.abstract: Understanding transcriptional responses to chemical perturbations is central to drug discovery, but exhaustive experimental screening of disease-compound combinations is unfeasible. To overcome this limitation, here we introduce PRnet, a perturbation-conditioned deep generative model that predicts transcriptional responses to novel chemical perturbations that have never experimentally perturbed at bulk and single-cell levels. Evaluations indicate that PRnet outperforms alternative methods in predicting responses across novel compounds, pathways, and cell lines. PRnet enables gene-level response interpretation and in-silico drug screening for diseases based on gene signatures. PRnet further identifies and experimentally validates novel compound candidates against small cell lung cancer and colorectal cancer. Lastly, PRnet generates a large-scale integration atlas of perturbation profiles, covering 88 cell lines, 52 tissues, and various compound libraries. PRnet provides a robust and scalable candidate recommendation workflow and successfully recommends drug candidates for 233 diseases. Overall, PRnet is an effective and valuable tool for gene-based therapeutics screening.
candidate.authors: Qi X, Zhao L, Tian C, Li Y, Chen ZL, Huo P, Chen R, Liu X, Wan B, Yang S, Zhao Y.

panel.reason: PRnet 扰动条件生成模型，预测新化合物转录响应
PRnet 扰动响应生成模型，公开代码，虚拟细胞代表工作

extraction.method: PRnet：扰动条件深度生成模型预测化学扰动转录响应
extraction.data: 约1亿bulk HTS观测、175,549化合物；数千万单细胞HTS、188化合物
extraction.scenario: 新化合物转录响应预测
extraction.results: PRnet可泛化到未实验扰动的新化合物，支持bulk和单细胞水平预测，并捕捉细胞异质性与基因级响应解释
extraction.limitations: 依赖训练数据覆盖；新化学空间外推仍具挑战
extraction.summary: 作者提出PRnet，一种扰动条件深度生成模型，用于预测新化学扰动在bulk和单细胞水平的转录响应。模型以化合物SMILES和未扰动转录谱为输入，通过Perturb-adapter、Perturb-encoder和Perturb-decoder实现未见化合物泛化。PRnet在近1亿bulk观测和数千万单细胞观测上训练，可解释基因级响应并捕捉细胞异质性。
